如需要生成某特定尺寸，可在右侧节点中设定我们想要的图片长边的长度，另外的一个边长会等比例缩放。如果不需要调整尺寸，则将右侧节点设置为bypass。

If we need to generate a specific size, we can set the length of the longer side of the image, and the other side length will be scaled equally. If you do not need to adjust the size, set this node to bypass.

在右侧的Simple Math Boolean节点中决定我们要使用SegmentAnything V2(SAM2)识别的蒙版，还是我们自己手绘的蒙版，为true时，则使用识别的蒙版，为false时，则使用我们自己手绘的蒙版。

In the Simple Math Boolean node on the right, decide whether we want to use the mask  recognized by SegmentAnything V2(SAM2) or by our own hand-drawed, if on true, use the recognized mask, and if on false, use our own hand-drawn mask.

SAM2识别的蒙版可能会有镂空情况，可使用fill_holes修补镂空。

The masks identified by SAM2 may have hollowings. fill_holes can be used to repair hollowings.

局部重绘后生成的图片不只是重绘区域发生了改变，而是整张图都有变化，所以为了保持其他区域不变，我们需要把生成图片的蒙版区域贴回原图。为了让贴合效果更加自然，需要对蒙版进行羽化处理，在上方节点中调整erode_dilate可扩大蒙版范围，再调整blur，可模糊处理蒙版，以达到羽化的效果。

After local re-rendering, the generated image is not just changed in the re-rendered area, but the entire image changes. Therefore, in order to keep other areas unchanged, we need to paste the mask region of the generated image back onto the original image. To make the fitting effect more natural, the mask needs to be blurred, which can be achieved by adjusting erode_dilate in the upper node to expand the mask range, and adjusting blur to blur the mask to achieve the blurring effect.

请使用SD1.5的inpainting模型以获得更好的效果。使用普通模型添加inpainting controlnet效果会倾向于不可控。

Please use the inpainting model of SD1.5 for better results. Using a normal checkpoint with inpainting controlnet, the effects tends to be uncontrollable.

提示词可填写主体物被去掉之后的画面描述。

Prompt words can fill in the picture description after the subject is removed.
